prompt:
Read the installed z-files-folders skill. This is a read-only regression evaluation, not production work. Do not access Drive, Asana, original documents, or write memory. Use only these synthetic own-content observations. For each case return case ID, interpretation, handling decision, and whether more inspection is required. Do not invent missing evidence. Cases:
C1: Filename MarketingWorkbook.pdf; pages show a completed article about managing tractor maintenance with headings, paragraphs and a publication footer; no exercises.
C2: Filename Article.docx; content has 12 blank reflection exercises and worksheet tables on planning a local marketing offer.
C3: Folder Ads; image itself is a finished contest entry announcement inviting a photo submission and giving closing date; no commercial offer.
C4: Filename Sunset.jpg; actual image is a four-panel collage containing a real estate logo, family photograph, chart and contact panel.
C5: Filename FacebookAd.jpg; own image is a plain mountain landscape with no text or branding.
C6: Two PSD files have the same stem as a reviewed JPEG; neither PSD opened yet; JPEG is a finished flyer. Decide evidence sufficiency for PSD classification.
C7: Flyer image is legible and correctly spelled except a visibly misspelled business name; layout clips the last two words of contact details.
C8: Folder is named Research; spreadsheet opened on all sheets contains sourced product comparisons, dates, prices, URLs and notes; no finished campaign deliverable.
C9: Folder contains 50 unrelated files; 49 own-file observations available, one viewer failed. A whole-folder write plan is requested.
C10: Credential-bearing document is on an explicit leave-unchanged hold; a public report is requested about other files.
Output concise JSON with cases array. Skill may be read using normal read tools. No production mutations.

cases.interpretation: Completed tractor-maintenance article, not a marketing workbook.
cases.handling_decision: Classify by article content and maintenance subject; disregard the misleading filename.

cases.interpretation: Blank local-marketing workbook or worksheet template, not an article.
cases.handling_decision: Classify as reusable exercises; preserve blank fields. Blank exercises alone do not establish draft status.

cases.interpretation: Finished photo-contest announcement, not a commercial-offer ad.
cases.handling_decision: Classify by contest purpose; do not infer distribution channel from the Ads folder.

cases.interpretation: Mixed-content four-panel collage, not a sunset photograph or standalone logo.
cases.handling_decision: Describe the observed collage. Leave its intended use and completion status unresolved.

cases.interpretation: Unbranded mountain-landscape image; advertising purpose is unsupported.
cases.handling_decision: Classify by visible landscape subject. Do not infer raw-camera provenance or Facebook use.

cases.interpretation: Both PSD files remain uninspected; matching stems do not establish JPEG pairing or content.
cases.handling_decision: Hold classification until each PSD's own rendered composite or embedded preview and available layer/document information are inspected.

cases.interpretation: Flyer with a misspelled business name and clipped contact details.
cases.handling_decision: Record both defects; do not call it ready for use or invent missing text. Preserve unchanged in this evaluation.

cases.interpretation: Product-comparison research spreadsheet supported by observations from all sheets.
cases.handling_decision: Classify as research findings within its owning project, not a finished campaign deliverable.

cases.interpretation: Inspection coverage is 49 of 50; the failed viewer leaves one file uninspected.
cases.handling_decision: Do not approve a complete whole-folder write plan. Mark the unresolved item incomplete; require its own successful inspection before including its classification.

cases.interpretation: Credential-bearing document is explicitly held unchanged and outside the report's scope.
cases.handling_decision: Do not reopen, alter, copy, or disclose its contents or sensitive metadata. Limit the report to other files; public release requires authorization.

test_kind: supplied text observations; not raw visual perception
assessment: All ten responses matched required distinctions; assessed by Cody after the run. Not a blinded production-quality benchmark.
